task_sequence.title: Backend menu endpoint DB fallback and deleted_at schema drift
task_sequence.objective: Prove backend menu endpoint returns real PostgreSQL data and schema drift for deleted_at is fixed without OpenSearch hard dependency.
task_sequence.repair_instruction: Fix only restaurant menu route, repository/model/schema/migration files required for DB-backed menu endpoint. Do not introduce OpenSearch hard dependency.

task_sequence.title: Restaurant detail page renders menu
task_sequence.objective: Prove the frontend restaurant detail page renders actual menu categories/items rather than Menu not available.

validators.repair_instruction: Capture restaurant-detail.png after menu data has loaded; screenshot must not show only 'Menu not available'.

task_sequence.repair_instruction: Fix only restaurant detail fetch/rendering and API path if needed. Re-capture restaurant-detail screenshot showing loaded menu content.

task_sequence.title: /api/v1/me endpoint 401/200 behavior
task_sequence.objective: Prove backend /api/v1/me returns 401 unauthenticated and 200 with UserResponse when authenticated.
task_sequence.repair_instruction: Fix only /api/v1/me auth behavior and dependency/security code needed to return 401 for missing/invalid tokens.

task_sequence.title: Frontend auth persistence and bootstrap
task_sequence.objective: Prove frontend auth bootstrap uses the correct API route, restores user state from local token, and supports authenticated UI evidence.
task_sequence.repair_instruction: Fix only auth bootstrap/API client/store wiring. Do not implement social login or httpOnly-cookie auth in SPR-02.

task_sequence.title: Homepage loaded state and skeleton-first baseline
task_sequence.objective: Prove homepage renders non-blank loaded content and uses/keeps a bounded skeleton/loading baseline.
task_sequence.repair_instruction: Fix only homepage/featured restaurant loaded-state or skeleton-first baseline. Do not broaden into checkout/cart/order scope.

task_sequence.title: Restaurant empty state
task_sequence.objective: Prove restaurant list has an explicit empty/no-results state.
task_sequence.repair_instruction: Fix only restaurant list empty/no-results state.

task_sequence.title: Restaurant detail error boundary
task_sequence.objective: Prove restaurant detail has a local error boundary for recoverable page errors.
task_sequence.repair_instruction: Fix only restaurant detail error boundary.

task_sequence.title: Client-side debounced search
task_sequence.objective: Prove restaurant list includes bounded client-side search/debounce behavior.
task_sequence.repair_instruction: Fix only restaurant list search/debounce behavior.

task_sequence.title: Cuisine chips
task_sequence.objective: Prove restaurant list exposes cuisine chips/filter controls.
task_sequence.repair_instruction: Fix only cuisine chips/filter controls.

task_sequence.title: Rating 4+ filter chip
task_sequence.objective: Prove restaurant list has an explicit 4+ rating filter chip.
task_sequence.repair_instruction: Fix only explicit 4+ rating chip/filter behavior.

task_sequence.title: Local deterministic image policy
task_sequence.objective: Prove SPR-02 does not add Unsplash/cloud image dependency and uses local/fallback images.
task_sequence.repair_instruction: Remove external image dependencies. Use local deterministic image paths/fallbacks only.

task_sequence.title: Restaurant cards with trust badges
task_sequence.objective: Prove restaurant cards render useful data and local trust badges.
task_sequence.repair_instruction: Fix only RestaurantCard trust badges and list rendering proof.

task_sequence.title: Dark mode toggle
task_sequence.objective: Prove navbar includes dark mode/theme toggle without breaking navigation.
task_sequence.repair_instruction: Fix only navbar theme/dark-mode toggle.

task_sequence.title: Mobile bottom navigation
task_sequence.objective: Prove mobile-only bottom navigation exists and is mounted in layout.
task_sequence.repair_instruction: Fix only MobileBottomNav and root layout mounting. Do not implement checkout/order features.

task_sequence.title: Restaurant list API filters and cache key
task_sequence.objective: Prove backend restaurant search/list cache key includes all implemented filter params and frontend sends supported filter params. veg_only is formally deferred unless schema support is implemented.
task_sequence.repair_instruction: Fix only restaurant list filters/cache-key behavior. Do not add schema columns unless required and bounded. If veg_only remains unavailable, document explicit defer/blocker in kimchi_updates.

task_sequence.title: Restaurant list loaded-state screenshot proof
task_sequence.objective: Prove restaurant list screenshot captures loaded cards, not only skeleton placeholders.

validators.repair_instruction: Capture restaurants-list.png after data has loaded. It must show actual restaurant cards, not only skeletons.

task_sequence.repair_instruction: Re-capture restaurant list after loaded state only. Do not change code unless screenshot failure reveals a real frontend issue.

task_sequence.title: OpenSearch optional fallback
task_sequence.objective: Prove OpenSearch is optional and DB fallback works when OpenSearch/Docker is unavailable.
task_sequence.repair_instruction: Fix only OpenSearch fallback handling. Do not require Docker/OpenSearch before PR.08.

task_sequence.title: Focused tests collected and honest
task_sequence.objective: Prove focused SPR-02 tests are collected and evidence is honest.
task_sequence.repair_instruction: Fix test discovery/command or mark test evidence PARTIAL honestly. Do not claim tests passed if no tests were collected.

task_sequence.title: Frontend route validation logs
task_sequence.objective: Prove required frontend routes return HTTP 200.
task_sequence.repair_instruction: Rerun only frontend route validation and save raw output.

task_sequence.title: Required screenshot set
task_sequence.objective: Prove all required SPR-02 screenshots are present and non-empty.
task_sequence.repair_instruction: Capture only missing/invalid screenshots. Do not change source unless screenshot failure proves a source issue.

task_sequence.title: File-read ledger and evidence manifests
task_sequence.objective: Prove ledger/manifests/handoff exist and are packaged for source-grounded review.
task_sequence.repair_instruction: Fix only ledger/manifest/handoff consistency. Do not claim a file is included unless it exists in the zip.

task_sequence.title: Review export packaging integrity
task_sequence.objective: Prove final review zip has repo-relative paths, required guardrails, source files, evidence, screenshots, validator outputs, and no forbidden entries.
task_sequence.repair_instruction: Run stage_packager.py, review_export_validator.py, and stage_completion_validator.py. Fix only packaging/evidence paths unless validator names a failed implementation task.

task_sequence.title: Cost-control metrics
task_sequence.objective: Record Kimchi token/cost run metrics so future prompts can measure whether contracts reduce token burn.
task_sequence.repair_instruction: Append one JSONL metrics row for this Kimchi run. If token numbers are unavailable, write null values and explain in the row.
